doc.description: Driver for use in a Parrot Minidrone all of which have a build in ultra sound ranging sensor Reads the ultra sound sensor and outputs a distance in [m]

define.name: USE_SONAR
define.description: If set does activate use of the ranging device in INS extended filter (only rotorcraft)

define.name: SONAR_OFFSET
define.description: Sonar offset to set if what should be zero(0) range is not

configure.name: PARROT_MINIDRONE_SONAR_BARO_THRESHOLD
configure.description: Altitude in meters above which the ranging is not used anymore
